title: What is the age
html_source: This section (from “What is the age” to “Leopold was for Rudolph”) is in the style of English writer Charles Lamb.

anchor.prefix: is uninhabited. No soul will live there. The spider pitches her web in the solitude. The nocturnal rat peers from his hole. A curse is on it. It is haunted. Murderer's ground.
anchor.suffix: of the soul of man? As she hath the virtue of the chameleon to change her hue at every new approach, to be gay with the merry and mournful with the downcast, so 1961#412too is her
